## About

Ashton's Auto Detailing is a mobile car detailing business founded and operated by Ashton, a young local entrepreneur born and raised in the Cowichan Valley. Every job uses P&S professional-grade detailing chemicals, UV-protective tire dressing, and paint protection sealant. The business comes directly to the customer's home or workplace — no drop-off required. Service is available 7 days a week across the Cowichan Valley region of Vancouver Island, BC.
